summary: Touchpoint (operating as touchpoint.io, legal entity Touchpoint Restaurant Innovations Inc., Palo Alto, CA) sells 'OmniFusion,' a platform unifying POS, kitchen display, online ordering, mobile apps, kiosks, gift cards, and loyalty for enterprise multi-location QSR, fast-casual, pizza, and coffee chains into a single managed portal.

Touchpoint markets differentiators of ~80% loyalty program participation (vs. a claimed ~15% industry average), 99.95% platform uptime with 5x redundancy, merchant ownership of transaction/member data in a private data warehouse, and compatibility with legacy Windows/Android/iOS hardware. (Scope note: Uptime, redundancy, and loyalty-participation figures are vendor-self-reported marketing claims, not independently audited.)

Company is founded/led by Israel L'Heureux, previously co-founder of Redline Networks (acquired by Juniper Networks); third-party company-data aggregators list approximately $5.2M raised to date with backers including Samudra Pacific Capital Partners and Linden3 Ventures. (Scope note: Funding figures come from data-aggregator sites (Tracxn/Crustdata), not a primary press release or SEC filing; treat as directionally indicative only until corroborated.)

No credible independent operator-review source with implementation, support, integration, reliability, pricing or usability shortcomings for this exact Touchpoint Restaurant Solutions entity was successfully opened.
